notes:
## New look
- Home, Settings and About are tabs at the top, and the whole window is yours.
- Your car is drawn in light, in its own colour, on Home and the loading screen.
- Launch E-Sys: one clean line per version. Pick one and press Launch, or double-click to start it at once.
- Light look: choose Dark or Light at the top right; it asks before it restarts.

## New
- PSdZData doctor: Home spots PSdZData in the wrong place (one folder too deep, in Downloads or Desktop), half unpacked or still zipped. Fix it points E-Sys at the right folder. Nothing is moved or deleted.
- Service history: on newer instrument clusters, every past service reset is listed with the car's own date and mileage.
- Ignition: click the KL15 plate to read it, or switch it on or off from the PC (on cars that support it).
- What's new after each update, shown once.
- Last session under Launch: which E-Sys, when, how long, the car it read.
- Copy setup for support in About: versions, PSdZData and checks to paste in a support chat.
- Ctrl+1/2/3 switch between Home, Settings and About.
- F-key shortcuts in E-Sys: F2 Connect, F3 Coding, F4 TAL-Processing, F6 FSC, F7 VCM, F9 Fault scan. Settings shows each key next to its screen; Change keys opens a clear window to pick them.

## Improved
- A new dark installer with the E-Sys MAX logo. Updates and removal show the same dark pages.
- Setup check in one card: E-Sys, PSdZData and the cable at a glance.
- About and Settings in two tidy columns.
- Free trial shown at the top with a Buy button.
- Clearer help when EDIABAS on this PC cannot start.

## Fixed
- Take me there finds VCM, FSC Extended and Coding-Verification on newer E-Sys.
- Fault clearing, restart, battery registration and ignition check the same car is still connected.
- Small fixes and checks.
